<!--
Exhibit section. Captions, numbering and figure→file mapping are taken from
narrative/diagnostics/exhibit_inventory_v005.md, extracted from
v005_CreditAgricProdGapGhana.docx -- not invented.

Layout rules:
  - one #### heading per exhibit, so Word's navigation pane lists them
  - ft_*() chunks for tables; bare ![](...){width=} for figures
  - the caption is the HEADING, not the image alt text
  - \newpage between exhibits

Orientation: Tables 1 and 4 are 8-9 columns and need landscape. A section marker
applies to the content BEFORE it, so content between markers takes the
orientation of the NEXT marker; back-to-back markers create a blank page. The
landscape blocks are commented out until the tables actually build -- adding
them now would only produce blank pages around absent content.

Tables 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 are LIVE; Table 4 is still a stub. The rest are commented out; their
builders are stubs that stop() with the reason and the next step. Uncomment each
as its builder lands. NO FALLBACKS: a builder that cannot key its data must
stop(), never drop back to a stored CSV.
-->
